Attribution.Conclusion: ArchLinterNet inner work is repeated once per independent process; in the 1-process sequential scenario, build_state_preflight is the dominant phase at 2615,5ms of 3205,0ms inner median (81,8%). No version regression is proven by this synthetic current-tree run; consumer-side timestamps and comparable versions are still required.
Attribution.Limitation: Outer process timing does not measure the caller's container or CI runner. Compare this artifact with consumer-side timestamps before asserting an external regression.

Routing.Decision: Feed the reusable large-multi-host process-count shape and per-process profile counters into the canonical benchmark foundation; do not create a competing framework.
Prepared-analysis reuse remains the owner for cross-process preparation; this harness measures duplication but does not implement reuse.
No selector/layer, real-MSBuild cache-eligibility, or changed-project advisory conclusion is asserted by this matrix.

MeasurementBoundary: The harness measures startup/process and ArchLinterNet profile boundaries only. Container, scheduler, restore-service, and CI-runner time require caller-side instrumentation.
